objective: Show the verified official AdMob preliminary gross revenue (100%), rule-driven Community Contribution pool (30%), non-pool remainder (70% plus cents), private personal QMP share ratio and estimated PHP allocation across BUKLOD Home contribution card and details. Never present estimates as cash or withdrawable.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: 2026-11-09 production BUKLOD Connect Supabase project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu has an official 2026-11 AdMob source snapshot amount_minor=864 PHP8.64, observed_at 2026-11-08 17:15:54 UTC, source_mode=OFFICIAL_ADMOB_API, period OPEN, rule_version community_qmp_v1 config.pool_bps=3000 (30%), 16 qualified accounts and 702 total QMP. Private get_my_buklod_community_contribution_live_v1 source verified against existing SQL migration: member estimate= floor(floor(gross_minor*pool_bps/10000)*user_qmp/total_qmp). API currently does not return gross / pool percent / remainder / effective gross share fields. UI Home card src/components/BuklodCommunityContributionCard.tsx and details src/app/community-contribution.tsx show only member estimated pesos and weight without complete financial breakdown. No change to payout, ledger, or official importer is required. Merged GitHub baseline main used after PR #593 v11 source is verified production; client deployed state not inferred.
acceptanceChecks: Source-backed fresh monthly gross only from private AdMob snapshot; no back-solving gross from rounded 30% pool
Use existing configured pool_bps, server cent flooring, and user-weight ratio; no client-side monetary authority
Show 100% gross, 30% pool, 70% plus rounding non-pool, total QMP, own QMP, own pool share percentage, own effective gross percentage and own cent-rounded estimate
Display only on PROVISIONAL_ADMOB after verifying exact gross=pool+remainder and configured bps; hide stale/missing/reconciled gross breakdown
No anonymous or cross-user direct snapshot access, no other user personal data displayed
Preserve existing QMP, finance, wallets, funding, referral, settlement, withdrawal, server scheduler, Expo runtime and screen navigation
Pass focused tests, database read-only SQL contract, PR QA; verify production migration and keep OTA unpublished until explicit release gate
chosenApproach: Add optional additive fields to existing authenticated read-only live_v1 RPC without changing its signature. Return gross cents, configured bps, non-pool cents, effective gross participation and source mode only in fresh provisional branch. Add typed client guard and UI rows in Home card/details, with precision and noncash notices.
selectionRationale: The server already computes the 30% pool and private member estimate correctly; UI lacks underlying gross and configured rate. An additive response extending its existing secure RPC avoids duplicate authorization, app-wide backend redesign or divergent client payout math.
alternativeApproaches: Infer gross in client by dividing rounded pool by 30%: rejected because rounding creates ambiguity, false displayed figures, and can conflict with configurable rules
Add a separate public revenue endpoint: rejected due privacy and duplicated backend/source reconciliation
Extend existing private read-only response with exact source-reconciled fields and visual breakdown: chosen
preserveBehaviors: Official AdMob OAuth import and scheduled function source unchanged
30% QMP pool remains server-rule configured; no change to share payout or rounding calculation
No new cash balance entitlement, no user-visible withdrawal eligibility, no finance ledger mutation
Existing private RLS/grants and Supabase auth user scoping preserved
Existing Home navigation, noncash estimate state and historical QMP information preserved
No automatic OTA or Android build deployment without release verification
